description: Structural early-stage redesign, profiled untimed before any accuracy run. Base: E116 code. Build three variants in a side script: (a) group 1's max-pool moved from after conv3 to after conv1, so the residual conv2/conv3 run at 15x15x128 instead of 31x31x128; (b) group-1 width 96 instead of 128, with group-2 conv1 input 96 and Muon stacks plus dirac init re-batched; (c) both. Compile and warm every (resolution, batch) x freeze x renorm x whiten-bias-grad shape. Measure ms/step and NVML energy over 20 steps per shape (16/24 px bs 1536, 28/32 px bs 1024, frozen 32 px variant), and project total time over the E116 schedule. Score at 100 seeds against the pooled E116 baseline only the variants projecting ≥8% saving, best projected first. Bar: loss ≤0.044 pp per 1% (fundable by 32 px re-spend). For the scored row, rerun E116 unchanged unless a variant qualifies.
